turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will not have you worrying about this now, O-lan, you must rest and think of your health, not of the future

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: But what will become of our son, Wang Lung, when I am gone? He will need a wife to care for him, and I must see to it that he is settled before I die.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry about me, I will be fine. I will marry and have children, and they will take care of me. You must not think about this now, you must rest and get better.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am not worried about myself, but about you and your future, son. What will become of you if I am not here to care for you?

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please don't worry about me. I will take care of myself, and Father will always be here to guide me.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You must not think of such things, O-lan. You must rest and get well, for my sake as well as the son's. He needs his mother's guidance and love.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know, Wang Lung, that I am not strong as I once was, but I must see my son settled before I go. It is the only thing that gives me peace.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, you must not worry about this now, you must rest and let me take care of everything.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I must see him married, Wang Lung, it is my duty, my last wish

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Do not speak of this now, my love, you must rest, it is enough that you have thought of this for our son

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My son, I have thought of this for a long time, and I must see it done before I go. You must not refuse me, my love

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, don't worry, I'll do as you say. I'll find a good wife and settle down, don't you worry about me.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am glad you are willing to do this, my son, but I fear I will not live to see it

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not say such things. Father will take care of me, and I will make you proud.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, you must rest now. Your health is all that matters to me, and to our son.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, don't worry about me. I'm old enough to take care of myself and start a new life, just as you've always wanted.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I've brought the tea, Mother, as you wished. I'll pour it for you now.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, do not strain yourself, I will take care of everything. Our son will be married and settled, just as you wish.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: But how can I rest now, Wang Lung? The marriage must be arranged, and I must see that my son is well-provided for.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: What foolishness is this, O-lan? You must rest now, and worry not about the marriage. I will take care of it, and see to it that our son is well-settled.
